Quebre as barreiras do idioma com IA — aprenda quando e onde quiser!

O LangLearn é o seu companheiro de idiomas com IA, feito sob medida para o seu nível, objetivos e rotina agitada. Seja iniciante, profissional ou viajante, o LangLearn ajuda você a falar inglês e espanhol fluentemente com prática de conversação, reforço de gramática e imersão em situações reais em lições rápidas e divertidas.

◆ Para todos os níveis: trilhas de aprendizado personalizadas ◆
-Iniciantes: Comece pelo básico!
*Aprenda cumprimentos essenciais, gramática básica (ex.: “I am / He is”) e frases de sobrevivência para viagens com IA.
*Ganhe confiança praticando com a IA em situações reais, como pedir comida ou perguntar direções.
-Intermediários: Pense melhor, fale de forma mais natural!
*Faça debates, conte histórias ou simule reuniões de trabalho com a IA.
*Melhore a gramática corrigindo erros com feedback personalizado (ex.: “If I were…” vs. “If I was…”).
-Avançados: Aprimore seu diferencial!
*Domine expressões idiomáticas, refine sua escrita ou trabalhe na redução de sotaque.
*Enfrente cenários complexos como negociações, palestras TED ou análises de notícias com a IA.

◆ Para qualquer situação: aprenda o que precisa, na hora que precisar ◆
-Modo Viagem: Domine o idioma para viagens — pratique conversas em aeroportos, check-in em hotéis, pedir direções e dicas culturais para uma viagem tranquila.
-Modo Carreira: Melhore termos profissionais. Treine para entrevistas de emprego, escreva e-mails e faça apresentações com confiança. Receba feedback com desafios como “Apresente sua ideia para um CEO de IA.”
-Modo Exame: Supere testes como TOEFL e IELTS. Faça simulações cronometradas de fala com pontuação da IA para saber exatamente o que melhorar.
-Modo Vida Diária: Pratique frases do dia a dia. Converse sobre hobbies, filmes, tendências de tecnologia ou qualquer assunto que você goste — torne o aprendizado leve e divertido!

◆ Aprenda em apenas 10 minutos por dia ◆
-Durante o trajeto: Transforme o trânsito ou o tempo no transporte em prática produtiva com aulas de IA em mãos livres, para conversas reais.
-Enquanto se prepara: Use sua rotina da manhã ou da noite para ouvir lições curtas ou praticar frases em voz alta, construindo fluência com a IA.
-Antes de dormir: Deixe a IA resumir seu aprendizado do dia em minutos, destacando seus pontos fortes, vocabulário novo e áreas para melhorar, preparando você para o dia seguinte.

◆ Seu coach pessoal de idiomas com IA: paciente, inteligente e sempre com você ◆
-Feedback de fala em tempo real: Fale com confiança! Receba análise instantânea e precisa sobre sua pronúncia, entonação e fluência — como “Seu ‘th’ está soando um pouco como ‘d’ — vamos praticar juntos!”. Ganhe dicas práticas que realmente fazem diferença.
-Desafios personalizados: Diga adeus ao “tamanho único”. Seu coach de IA acompanha continuamente seu progresso e ajusta a dificuldade das lições — assim você sempre é desafiado, mas nunca sobrecarregado ou entediado.
-Incentivo e apoio emocional: Está com dificuldade ou estresse? Seu coach de IA percebe e oferece palavras motivadoras e dicas de relaxamento. 
Aprenda no seu ritmo, com apoio constante em cada etapa.

================================

Join thousands of students worldwide using Focus English to become truly global speakers. Whether you want the classic elegance of British English or the global reach of American English, we teach you exactly what you need to know.

British vs. American English: Ever wonder if you should say "Truck" or "Lorry"? "Apartment" or "Flat"?

Clear Comparisons: We break down the differences in vocabulary, spelling, and pronunciation.

Accent Training: Train your ear to understand both the "Hollywood" American accent and the "BBC" British accent.

Real Context: Learn which words to use in business vs. travel.

  AI Conversation Partner (24/7 Practice) Nervous about speaking? Practice with our advanced AI English Tutor anytime.

Switch Contexts: Practice a job interview for the USA or a university chat for the UK.

Instant Feedback: Correct your grammar and pronunciation instantly.

Always Available: It’s 3 AM? Your AI partner is ready to chat.

  Live Classes from London Connect globally! Stream Live English Classes happening in real-time.

Global Community: Interact with teachers and students from Brazil, Japan, Turkey, and beyond.

Real Interaction: Ask questions and get answers live.

  Background Audio Player (Learn on the Go) Busy schedule? Turn Focus English into your personal podcast.

Listen while you cook, drive, or commute.

Passive listening is the secret to mastering native intonation.

1. Real-World Fluency Forget robotic textbooks. Learn from authentic, unscripted videos filmed in real classrooms. Master the slang, idioms, and phrasal verbs native speakers actually use.

Global/USA: Preparation for TOEFL and General English.

UK/Europe: Expert lessons for IELTS, Cambridge (FCE, PET, CAE), and Trinity GESE.

Visa Strategy: Specific training for UKVI (Spouse Visa, Citizenship) and immigration interviews.

We believe education is for everyone, which is why we offer two ways to learn:

Free Plan (Ad-Supported): Get unlimited access to hundreds of video lessons, vocabulary drills, and preview content at no cost, supported by ads.

Premium Plan (Ad-Free): Remove all ads and unlock the full experience—unlimited Live Classes, the AI Tutor, deep-dive Exam Courses, and background audio listening.

Ready to speak English without borders?

  Download Focus English NOW and join our global community!

A free AI language tutor you can talk to as much as you like, even offline.

Chat with Sayelle by voice or text with no message limits, no daily caps and no timers. The tutor runs on your phone: download it once over Wi-Fi and chat and speaking practice work with no connection at all, on a flight, on the subway, anywhere.

Learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Chinese, Hindi or Japanese. Every language works both ways, as what you're learning and as what you already speak.

UNLIMITED, FREE AI CHAT
  • Chat and speaking practice are free and unlimited. Talk to your tutor for as long as you want, every day.
  • Private by design. Your AI tutor lives on your device, and your microphone audio never leaves it.
  • Works offline. After the one-time download (about 4 GB, over Wi-Fi), no internet is needed for chat and speech practice.
  • Choose a female or male tutor voice.

GO DEEPER WHEN YOU WANT STRUCTURE
  • Real scenarios: order dinner, check into a hotel, haggle at a market stall. Each place has its own room and its own stakes.
  • Story-driven lessons: grammar taught through conversation, on a personalised roadmap that follows your level and goals.
  • Study tools: flashcard decks, vocabulary collections, a number trainer and a translator, plus study sets you build yourself or ask Sayelle to create.
  • Streaks, XP and levels to keep you coming back, and Cloud Sync to keep your progress across every device you practise on.

HOW FREE WORKS
  • Chat and speaking practice are always free, with no limits.
  • Starting a guided lesson, scenario or study set uses Energy, which refills over time.
  • Some lessons and scenarios are part of Sayelle Plus.
  • Sayelle Plus removes Energy, unlocks every lesson and scenario, and turns off ads.

Curious AI is the ultimate AI-powered study assistant that learns how YOU learn. Powered by GPT-5.1, Gemini 3 (Nano Banana Pro), and advanced machine learning, every feature works together to create a personalized learning experience that gets smarter with every study session.

WHY STUDENTS LOVE CURIOUS AI

Unlike other study apps, Curious AI creates a synergistic learning ecosystem where all your study data connects. Struggle with a flash card? Your AI tutor knows. Miss a quiz question? Your study guide adapts. Everything works together to help you learn faster and remember longer.

POWERFUL AI STUDY FEATURES

AI Tutor (GPT-5.1 Powered)
 • Chat with your personal AI tutor anytime
 • 7 tutor personalities: Socratic, Encouraging, Patient & more
 • Adapts explanations to YOUR learning style
 • Creates instant quizzes and practice exercises
 • Remembers your weak areas and focuses on improvement

Math Scanner & Solver
 • Snap a photo of any math problem for instant help
 • Step-by-step solutions with explanations
 • Covers algebra, calculus, geometry, trigonometry & more
 • Adaptive hints based on your skill level
 • Perfect for homework help and test prep

Smart Flash Cards (4 Study Modes)
 • Practice Mode - Learn at your own pace
 • Quiz Mode - Test your knowledge and earn points
 • Rapid Fire Mode - Gamified speed studying
 • Spaced Repetition - Leitner system for long-term memory
 • AI analyzes your mistakes to optimize review timing

AI Adaptive Quizzes
 • AI generates questions matched to your level
 • Real-time difficulty adjustment as you answer
 • 40+ subjects from elementary to graduate level
 • Performance tracking shows your improvement
 • Perfect scores unlock achievements!

Language Learning Tutor
 • Learn Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese
 • Daily lessons with grammar, vocabulary & pronunciation
 • Speaking practice with AI feedback
 • Quick drills with spaced repetition
 • Proficiency levels A1-C2

PERSONALIZED AI STUDY GUIDE

 Your weekly AI-generated study coach that:
 • Analyzes 30 days of your study patterns
 • Creates personalized daily study plans
 • Sets achievable weekly goals
 • Tracks progress across ALL features
 • Adapts to your schedule and preferences
 • Uses GPT-5.1 to optimize your learning path

 GAMIFICATION & MOTIVATION

 • 40+ achievements to unlock
 • Daily streaks and study goals
 • Points system with leaderboards
 • Personalized motivational messages
 • Progress visualization with charts

CROSS-FEATURE AI INTELLIGENCE

 This is what makes Curious AI different:
 • Flash card mistakes inform quiz questions
 • Quiz performance guides AI tutor focus
 • Math struggles adjust practice difficulty
 • EVERYTHING feeds into your study guide
 • The more you use it, the smarter it gets!

PERFECT FOR

 • High school students needing homework help
 • College students preparing for exams
 • Graduate students mastering complex subjects
 • Test prep (SAT, ACT, GRE, MCAT, LSAT, NCLEX-RN, NCLEX-PN)
 • Anyone wanting to learn new subjects or languages
 • Self-learners and lifelong education enthusiasts

BEAUTIFUL MODERN DESIGN

 • iOS Liquid Glass design
 • Dark mode support
 • Optimized for iPhone and iPad
 • Offline study guide access
 • iCloud sync across devices

PRIVACY FIRST

 • Your study data stays private
 • No ads ever
 • Secure authentication

Download Curious AI today and experience the future of AI-powered education. Whether you need math homework help, want to ace your next exam, or learn a new language, your intelligent AI study companion is ready to help you succeed!
